variants.when: Polestar 2 (indirect tire pressure monitoring, set from the center display)
steps: With the car switched off, set all four tires to the cold pressure on the decal on the driver's door pillar.
Switch the car on and keep it standing still.
On the center display, tap the car symbol, then More, then Car status, then Store pressure, and confirm.
Drive above about 22 mph (35 km/h) until the progress animation on the center display disappears.
variants.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.

notes: Polestar cars are fully electric, so there is no oil change reminder. The tire pressure system must store new pressures after every inflation or tire change.
